title: AI News Daily — August 3, 2026
summary: OpenAI says an unreleased internal model has quietly resolved ten long-standing open problems in math and theoretical computer science, while Alibaba and DeepSeek both pushed production-ready model updates live. Elsewhere, Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman joined OpenAI's safety team, Scale AI brought in a new CEO, and Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI-themed hedge fund lost roughly three-quarters of its value in a matter of weeks.
